notes.title: DEMO UPDATE! (CREATURE COLLECTOR EVENT UPDATE)
notes.content:
Berserk B.I.T.S is part of the Creature Collector Fest on Steam! And for the occasion we’re giving all B.I.T Device owners, (new and old) a firmware update for the demo! 

Included in this update: 

- A save button on your device + Automatic periodic saving (no more file corruptions) 
- New Long Press Buttons for the BIT device settings menu 
- Japanese and Simplified Chinese Language support 
- Vertical monitor mode (can be selected from the options menu)
- Scale your Home Board! Pinch your HomeBoard and drag it to resize + Scale it
- New Level Cap (105) 
- Performance upgrades

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097745/18789534d39b3e3077f9c8d4bb0fa02929911eb7.png[/img]

notes.title: A HOT FIX AS HOT AS YOUR BATTLING SKILLS
notes.content:
Hey hey! 

We've fixed a few things with the demo! -- 

- Huge Lag spike if you click on your chip selection screen 

- A crash that prevents you reloading your save  (your save should just load now) 

- Monitor issues. If you have a vert monitor / linux we still don't have a fix for you yet, but if your monitor was causing the game to dissapear into the void, it should be fixed. (IF ITS NOT, the game will default to your primary monitor on start up. so you *CAN* play the game on that monitor at least. sorry for the inconvenience... we are slowly learning everyones machines are different :')) 

Thank you!! <3 

More fixes and changes are coming as we try make this demo the thing to hold everyone over until launch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097745/18789534d39b3e3077f9c8d4bb0fa02929911eb7.png[/img]

notes.title: YOUR B.I.T DEVICE IS BEING UPDATED!
notes.content:
[b]NET DETECTIVE:[/b][i] Please Update your B.I.T Device!  
[/i]
[b]Hey Everyone! [/b] 

As a[b] massive thank you[/b] for such warm reception on [b]Berserk B.I.T.S[/b], we’ve decided to update the demo with a[b] TONNE of new features[/b] and [b]requests[/b] people have wanted.

We’ll obviously continue to work on the game. We just wanted to give a nice update during NEXT FEST and show you how[b] all of your feedback is being added in the game[/b]! ːsteamhappyː

[b]A list of just some of the features are below: [/b]

- Moveable Board Pieces
- Pixel Perfect aspect ratios
- Drag tool bar items
-Cloud saving (take your save to multiple machines, through STEAM)
- Summary of each run
- LOOP function (to leave your BIT running in battle)
- Random Chatting with BIT (phrases in and out of battle)
- BIGGER FONT
- Better optimization (we hope this works) 
-Wide Screen support (we hope this works) 
- BRAND NEW DEX (it’s great)
-More than 2 monitor detection
- Showing attack + health stats of your BIT
- a ‘read all’ e-mail function
-Lock Decorations on the board
- using the scroll wheel to navigate certain menus + on the board
- Mining is always prioritized when mining tool is equipped
- Feeding BOTS requires you to let go of your food (no more accidental drive by feeding)
- BOTS do not level down when stored
-(and just a tonne of bug fixes) 

[b]THANK YOU SO MUCH FOR YOUR SUPPORT! [/b]

If you have other requests, wants + want to talk about the game in general. 
Come join our discord! <3 

https://discord.gg/uEyG5tfDzQ
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097745/18789534d39b3e3077f9c8d4bb0fa02929911eb7.png[/img]

notes.title: Happy New Year!!!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I hope you've had a great holiday break! 

Just an update from our side on Berserk B.I.T.S. 

2025 will be the year we launch!!  

We've also been hard at work on getting the game ready for a Demo, and just creating the full game in general. 

As a little update from us, there's just a few things I want to confirm: 

- You'll be able to import your OWN CREATIONS TO BE YOUR B.I.T! -- all you'll need is their sprite sheet to import. 

- The game will have Biomes and missions for you to clear 

- we're aiming for around 100 BattleChips at launch

- we're hoping to get a demo ready sooner rather than later! 

- Here's a look at our current cast of B.I.T.S for you to use! 



We hope you're excited to have your own little virtual buddy, battling at the bottom of your screen! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097745/87ec606302338d1a6d2af295e5f151ef627cb6b4.jpg[/img]



-Zu
